# EXPRESS grammar — PARG edition 2 (skeleton).
#
# The translation of lib/expressir/express/grammar/parser.rb, rule by
# rule; see CONVENTIONS.md for the mapping and the parity-critical
# surfaces. This skeleton carries the trivia machinery only: it compiles
# and self-checks, proving the toolchain loop while the 252-rule body
# translation proceeds in RULE-INVENTORY.txt order.
grammar ExpressSyntax version "0.1.0" edition 2 {

  # match[" \r\n\t\f"].repeat(1)
  trivia = 1*(%x20 / %x0D / %x0A / %x09 / %x0C)

  # The DSL's skip(:trivia, whitespace: :space, exempt: ...) — the
  # exempted rules become `atomic` declarations as they land; the
  # remark rules stay OUT of the skip surface (they are product data).
  skip = trivia capture: space

  # Placeholder entry: whitespace-only acceptance, until the rule body
  # translation fills in (each landed rule replaces this line's
  # dependencies, never the header or the skip declaration).
  syntax = *trivia

  entry syntax: syntax
}
